answer: Producing 68 answers an epoch therefore costs 28 real forward passes, and the pearl record lets any auditor recompute the check. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as an ivory header. Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a ferrous spot-check that re-runs the prompt.
